author: Kiandra
html: Tried doing this as a plain JavaFX project but it didn’t work. module-info.java can’t find javafx.controls, and HelloWorld.java can’t use any JavaFX elements. Using version 15 of ZuluFX and IntelliJ IDEA Community 2020.2.

author: Carl Dea
html:
Kiandra,
You maybe having the same issue with your module path or downloading an incorrect JDK for your operating system (contain jfx modules).

Let’s take some baby steps and focus on the simpler plain project (“A JavaFX App on ZuluFX in 60 Seconds”) without an IDE.

Sometimes You’ll find it easier to specify command line commands to see what’s going on.

Carl

author: Kiandra
html: Found the problem. I downloaded Zulu JDK instead of Zulu JDK FX. Make sure you download the right one! Thank you Carl for all the help.
